title: A `candidateTolerance` whose exponent overflows the double
why: Its sibling `document-unreadable-fractional-candidate-tolerance` covers the spelling that *rounds onto* an integer; this covers the one that overflows past every integer. Both are an exponent where `v1` requires canonical digits, and both are unrecoverable once parsed — so answering `document-unreadable` for one and an attributed `schema-invalid` for the other makes the verdict turn on how large the exponent happened to be.
